text:
Devon H: Hey team, seeing a weird spike where requests from EU customers are getting routed to us-east for bursts even though eu-primary has headroom. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/r/route-stall - looks like a chain of tiny redirects that keep moving the request around :confused:
Maya R: ugh. any correlation with the new tier-steering weights we rolled last night?
Devon H: Possibly. Changed weights from 0.7->0.55 for pro-tier to reduce cost. But the logs show repeated variant selection attempts: model v1 -> v1-quant -> v2-fallback -> v1 again. It's like a variant spiral.
Liam K: Can you paste a sample request_id and the route_decision trace? need the route hops.
Devon H: request_id=rid_8b3c9a, extracted trace: "route_decision": ["eu-primary:v1:reject(soft_quota)", "eu-primary:v1-quant:timeout", "us-east:v2:accept"]. The problem is eu-primary returns soft_quota and then we try v1-quant which times out quickly, triggers cross-region fallback. Then routing rules see the increased latency and throttle eu-primary more. Repeat.
Samir P: This is the classic feedback loop: quota/latency -> fallback -> cross-region -> throttle -> fallback. We saw something similar last year but not at this scale.
Elaine: ops-bot alert fired a HIGH on "route-oscillation" ~ 07:12 UTC and again at 07:18. Links: incident runbook GDoc /incidents/route-oscillation.
ops-bot: Incident 2026-07-12-RO1 created. Paging: @Maya R @Liam K @Samir P. Auto-collected traces attached.
Maya R: quick mitigation idea: add a circuit-breaker on consecutive cross-region fallbacks per-request and a pin-to-origin TTL for a short window (20s). If pinned, we skip variant fallback to other regions.
Liam K: I like pinning. Also suggest we treat soft_quota differently: instead of immediate fallback to another region, we try delayed short backoff + async cache warm + prefix-KV check. For soft_quota we can attempt a single retry on same region with reduced batch size.
Samir P: Can we update the routing config via console rollout (fast rollback)? The current rollout UX makes toggles awkward; I'd rather flip a policy flag than push a routing-policy change.
Maya R: There's a feature flag "routing.experimental.quick-eject" but it was disabled. We can enable it per-tenant from the Console -> Feature flags. UX request: we need a one-click "safety eject" that sets pin-to-origin and disables cross-region fallbacks for selected tenants. Filing a small product ticket.
Devon H: For immediate fix let's do a targeted change: 1) enable per-request circuit-breaker for cross-region after 1 fallback 2) set pin-to-origin TTL=30s for pro/pro-plus 3) treat soft_quota as retry-within-region. Can ops run the change for the affected tenants?
Elaine: I'll open a dedicated run and coordinate with infra to deploy config change to eu-primary routing service only.
Liam K: Also adding telemetry: include a numeric "route_hop_count" and boolean "pinned" in the access log, plus capture last_decision_reason field. That will make dashboards show oscillation earlier.
Samir P: On dashboards — adding a panel for 99th percentile hop_count by region + tenant tier. Also alert when avg_hop_count > 1.3 for 5m.
Maya R: Quick config snippet I'm going to apply (pseudo):
```
routing_policy: 
  tier_steering: 
    pro: weight: 0.6
  fallback: 
    cross_region_limit_per_request: 1
    pin_to_origin_ttl_seconds: 30
    soft_quota_behavior: retry_same_region_with_backoff
```
Devon H: Nice. Can someone push that to staging first and run a replay of recent traces? I want to ensure it doesn't create a dense single-region overload.
Liam K: I'll run the replay job against eu-primary staging with the same QPS. Also will add a canary that rejects more aggressively to validate fallback suppression.
Elaine: Rolling to prod for affected tenants only after staging green. ETA 25 minutes. Will post updates.
ops-bot: Deployment started for routing-policy-change (id=deploy_9921) targeting tenants [redwood-pro-123, redwood-pro-456].
Devon H: After deploy, we should watch these metrics: route_hop_count, cross_region_rps, eu_primary_queued, eu_primary_avg_latency.
Samir P: Postmortem items: (1) routing policy should have simulation mode in Console so we can preview fallbacks before rollout, (2) Dashboard with per-tenant hop_count baseline, (3) Make soft_quota less noisy in telemetry.
Maya R: Filed follow-ups: PROD-718 (Console one-click safety eject), INFRA-520 (telemetry fields), DASH-234 (hop_count panel).
Elaine: Prod deploy complete. Early signs: route_hop_count 99p dropped from 2.1 -> 1.0 for impacted tenants. cross_region_rps down 82%.
Devon H: Awesome. Thanks everyone. Let's keep the canary for 24h and then consider bringing back tier weight change but with safer guardrails. :thumbsup:
Maya R: Adding retrospective notes to runbook and linking the traces.
Liam K: I'll follow up with a small test harness that injects soft_quota signals to ensure no regression.
ops-bot: Incident 2026-07-12-RO1 resolved. Duration 58m.
